### Overview

Perform Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA) on RSEM-derived TPM expression for multiple brain tumor histologies, using GO Biological Process terms, and assess differential pathway activity.

### Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(2025)

# Core libraries
library(GSVA)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(rprojroot)
library(tidyverse)
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir-paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-rna-expression")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")
```

### Load histology file

```{r all-hist}
all_hist <- c("DIPG or DMG","EPN","LGG","MB") # exclude ATRT, HGG, GNT
normal_ids <- c("B1","B2","B3","B4","B5")
```

```{r load-histology}
# Load and annotate histology file
histology_df <- read_delim(file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "histology-preprocessing", "results", "histologies.tsv")) %>%
  filter(experimental_strategy == "RNA-Seq") %>% 
  # Fill in any missing histology with "Normal"
  mutate(histology = if_else(is.na(histology), "Normal", histology)) %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(
      sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
      sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" ~ paste0(histology, "-adjacent Normal"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    histology_condition = case_when(
      sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
      sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" ~ "Normal-Tumor Adjacent",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r pair-status}
paired_info <- histology_df %>%
  group_by(histology, sample_id) %>%
  summarize(
    tumor = any(sample_type == "Tumor"),
    adjacent_normal = any(sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pair_status = case_when(
    tumor & adjacent_normal ~ "Paired",
    TRUE ~ "Unpaired"
  ))

# Create table of paired/unpaired counts per histology
summary_table <- paired_info %>%
  group_by(histology, pair_status) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pair_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

print(summary_table)
```

```{r pull-bioassay_ids}
interest_bioassay_ids <- histology_df %>%
  filter(histology %in% c("DIPG or DMG", "MB", "LGG", "EPN", "Normal")) %>%
  pull(Bioassay_ID)
```

### Load file

```{r load-file}
# Path to the RDS containing TPM expression (genes × samples)
tpm_rds <- file.path(data_dir, "gene-expression-rsem-tpm-collapsed.all.rds")

# Load into R
expr_tpm <- readRDS(tpm_rds)

# Subset to only the Bioassay_IDs of interest
expr_tpm <- expr_tpm[, interest_bioassay_ids, drop = FALSE]

# Log2‐transform
expr_mat <- log2(as.matrix(expr_tpm) + 1)
```

### Load GO–BP Gene Sets

```{r load go-bp}
go_bp_df <- msigdbr(
  species    = "Homo sapiens",
  category   = "C5",
  subcategory= "BP"
) %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

go_bp_list <- split(go_bp_df$gene_symbol, go_bp_df$gs_name)
```

### Run GSVA

```{r run-gsva, warning=FALSE}
gsva_scores_param <- gsvaParam(expr_mat,
                               geneSets = go_bp_list,
                               kcdf = "Gaussian",
                               maxSize = 1500)

gsva_scores <- gsva(gsva_scores_param, verbose = TRUE)
```

```{r save gsva-scores}
gsva_scores %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Pathway") %>%
  write_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "gobp-gsva-scores.tsv"))
```

### Run differential expression analysis on pathway GSVA scores

```{r set-keywords}
# Identify keywords in GO terms for plotting (provided by Dalia)
keywords <- "immunity|T cell|immune|leukocyte|lymphocyte|myeloid|signal transduction|transforming growth factor beta|MAPK cascade|autophagy|cell death|glial cell|Ras|small GTPase|secretion|intracellular signal transduction|phosphorylation|cell comm|cell adhesion|defense"
```

```{r}
plot_heatmap <- function(top30, ids, hist, constrast){

    mat <- gsva_scores[top30, ids, drop=FALSE]
    # label
    rownames(mat) <- gsub("^GOBP_", "", top30)
    col_meta <- histology_df %>% filter(Bioassay_ID %in% ids)
    # order columns: Tumor then Normal
    col_ord <- col_meta %>% arrange(desc(sample_type)) %>% pull(Bioassay_ID)
    mat <- mat[, col_ord, drop=FALSE]
    colnames(mat) <- col_meta %>% arrange(desc(sample_type)) %>% pull(external_sample_id)
    # plot
    pheatmap(mat,
             fontsize = 8,
             treeheight_row = 10,
             color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "darkorange"))(6),
             cluster_cols = FALSE,
             filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(hist, "_", constrast, "_GSVA_DE_heatmap.pdf")),
             width = 12)
        message("   ✓ Plotted heatmap for ", hist, "/", constrast)
        
}
```

```{r de-gsva, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
for (hist in all_hist) {
  message("Histology: ", hist)
  
  # paired analysis
  paired_sample_ids <- paired_info %>%
    filter(histology == hist, pair_status == "Paired") %>%
    pull(sample_id)
  
  paired_ids <- histology_df %>%
    filter(sample_id %in% paired_sample_ids) %>%
    pull(Bioassay_ID)
  
  if(length(paired_ids)>=2) {
    mat_p <- gsva_scores[, paired_ids, drop=FALSE]
    meta_p <- histology_df %>%
      filter(Bioassay_ID %in% paired_ids) %>%
      mutate(condition = if_else(sample_type == "Tumor", "Tumor", "Normal")) %>%
      # ensure 'condition' is a factor with 'Normal' baseline
      mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")))
    design_p <- model.matrix(~ sample_id + condition, data=meta_p)
    fit_p <- lmFit(mat_p, design_p) %>% eBayes()
    res_p <- topTable(fit_p, coef = "conditionTumor", number = Inf) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Pathway") %>%
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(adj.P.Val)
    if (nrow(res_p)) write_tsv(res_p, file.path(results_dir, paste0(hist, "_paired_GSVA_DE_results.tsv")))
    
    if(nrow(res_p)==0) next
    top30 <- res_p %>%
      filter(stringr::str_detect(Pathway, regex(keywords, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
      slice_min(order_by=adj.P.Val, n=30) %>%
      pull(Pathway)
    
    plot_heatmap(top30, paired_ids, hist, "paired")
  }
    
  # healthy normal comparision
  healthy_ids <- histology_df %>%
    filter(histology==hist & sample_type=="Tumor" | external_sample_id %in% normal_ids) %>% pull(Bioassay_ID)
  
  if(length(healthy_ids)>=2) {
    mat_h <- gsva_scores[, healthy_ids, drop=FALSE]
    meta_h <- histology_df %>%
      filter(Bioassay_ID %in% healthy_ids) %>%
      mutate(condition = if_else(sample_type == "Tumor", "Tumor", "Normal")) %>%
      # ensure 'condition' is a factor with 'Normal' baseline
      mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")))
    design_h <- model.matrix(~ condition, data=meta_h)
    fit_h <- lmFit(mat_h, design_h) %>% eBayes()
    res_h <- topTable(fit_h, coef = "conditionTumor", number = Inf) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Pathway") %>%
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(adj.P.Val)
    if (nrow(res_h)) write_tsv(res_h, file.path(results_dir, paste0(hist, "_healthyNormal_GSVA_DE_results.tsv")))
    
    if(nrow(res_h)==0) next
    top30 <- res_h %>%
      filter(stringr::str_detect(Pathway, regex(keywords, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
      slice_min(order_by=adj.P.Val, n=30) %>%
      pull(Pathway)
    
    plot_heatmap(top30, healthy_ids, hist, "healthyNormal")
  }
}
```
